notes: LSX variable-latency floating-point instruction. Latency measured with a reset helper that keeps element 0 at the test value; throughput measured with 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover special values, exact/non-exact cases, subnormals, and overflow/underflow boundaries. Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
